name: Steel Frame - Wooden Shelf
description: A wooden shelf built on an exposed steel frame, mixing an industrial support structure with warmer wood shelving. It holds up to 24 small to medium items across its tiers, making it a practical option for anyone who needs real storage capacity rather than a purely decorative shelf.
highlights: Exposed steel frame paired with wood shelving for an industrial-modern look
Holds up to 24 small to medium items across its tiers
Practical enough for real storage, not just display
installation: Once the file is installed and inZOI is running, open Build Mode and switch to the Furniture catalog. Search for "Steel Frame Shelf" to find the piece, it is listed under that name in the build menu, not under "MOOSTYLES." If it does not show up, confirm the mod is enabled in your mod manager and that you are on the tracked game version listed above before reporting it as missing.

fileManifest.description: A simple steel frame wooden shelf. Holds up to 24 small to medium sized items.
